title: Still, motion, or sound?
intro: The image and video formulas overlap — deliberately confusable. Sort each prompt fragment by the capability it actually needs.

buckets.label: Works for a still image
buckets.hint: Subject, scene, camera position, light, style

cards.text: "Low-angle shot with shallow depth of field"
"Minimalistic vector art on a white background"
"A slow zoom reveals the diagram piece by piece"
"The camera pans left as she walks to the board"
"Pacing builds from a calm open to a rapid finish"
"A clock ticks; chalk squeaks against the board"
"She asks: 'so what does the square on the hypotenuse equal?'"

debrief: Camera *position* (angle, framing, depth of field), lighting, and style live in both formulas — a still can hold them. What a still can't hold is time: temporal pacing and camera *movement* are the video formula's Main and Camera additions, and dialogue + sound effects belong to its Audio group (Veo generates native audio, so sound is genuinely part of the prompt). If a fragment describes change or noise, it needs the video formula.
